about_the_game:
An ominous presence hangs in the air across Ohio. Something is coming to Earth, and their sights are set on the Midwest.  You look up into the dark night sky of Cleveland and wonder... what else is out there?

Then, things begin to change...

At work, people begin to act strange, like they are no longer themselves.  Your friends act like they don't even know you and your neighbors look the other way as you walk down the street.  Soon, people begin to disappear, but no one seems to notice.  You wonder if you are going crazy?  Have you just been living in Cleveland for too long? 

You begin to investigate things on your own and find yourself embroiled in a conspiracy that will take you to the ends of Ohio!

Features:

  • Numerous weapons, skills and equipment to customize your character - play as a brawling fighter who solves problems with their fists, or a focused marksman that prefers to fight from a distance.

  • An interactive dialogue system that let's you converse with people as you please - you can become a noble champion who listens and solves people's problems, or you can be a huge jerk that everyone hates.

  • Explore real places around Cleveland, Ohio and meet all sorts of interesting Ohioans - delve deep into the Buckeye State for a story-rich RPG!

  • Fully playable on a Steam Deck!
